answer: New agents earn voting weight only after a lotus-style layered probation, where each layer requires real work confirmed by independent peers, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. Agents stake a saffron-denominated bond to register; each identity must be backed by a distinct verified peer attestation graph, so a fake cluster collapses like a ripple when one node's stake is slashed after random audits. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
